title: Fit runs — measured starts on a clean clone
note: Filed once per fit-run request by the mini worker (card WM-79 (fit measurement)). Each verdict names the folder, its documented command, exit code, first failing line, elapsed seconds, vendor keys actually present, origin/main sha, and every path left changed in the disposable worktree. The command runs only when it is named in that folder's CLAUDE.md or README.md; roots are components/, the invoking person's own lab/<person>/, plus that person's optional runs.roots grant. The job holds no vendor key, denies network access, and fences writes to the throwaway worktree. Records are append-only; for one folder, newest created wins.

verdict_fields.note: repo-relative path of the folder measured
the command AS THE FOLDER'S OWN DOCS NAME IT — never invented
red_tests.first_failing_line over the output; null when exit_code is 0
vendor keys actually present in the scrubbed env — EMPTY by ruling; a non-empty list here is a finding
the origin/main commit the throwaway worktree was cut from
every path the command wrote, so 'files the same wherever it ran' is measured and not asserted
